names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 647, «Домнин Солунский (Фессалоникийский), мч.», with the rank word left off and the parenthesised second form of the city left to this note.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «έζησε στα τέλη του 3ου αιώνα μ.Χ. (περί το 288 μ.Χ.)».

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 1 октября ст. ст. — «Мч. Домнина Солунского (ок. 284-305).»

attestations.note: Where saint.gr gives «περί το 288 μ.Χ.» the Russian gives «ок. 284-305», which is Diocletian's reign rather than a year. That is the wider reading of the same martyrdom, so the folder's date is left as the Greek source stated it and the reign is recorded here.
